title: docs: use the title attribute on embedded videos
body:
`<docs-video>` only reads `src` and `title` (docs-video.mts:20-21), so the `alt` on two pages is dropped and the play link falls back to "Play video". Switch them to `title`, fix the kitchen-sink prose that teaches `alt`, and add the spec assertion
that would have caught it.
